# PrairieCare

> > PrairieCare is a Minnesota-based psychiatric mental healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment programs for children, teens, and adults across multiple locations.

PrairieCare operates psychiatric care facilities throughout Minnesota, including Twin Cities, Rochester, and Mankato locations. The organization specializes in comprehensive mental health services ranging from screening and outpatient care to intensive treatment programs.

## Key Topics

- Psychiatric Mental Healthcare
- Evidence-Based Treatment
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Mental Health Screening
- Inpatient Care
- Outpatient Services
- Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
- Adult Mental Health
- Minnesota Locations
- Twin Cities
- Rochester
- Mankato
- Treatment Programs

## About PrairieCare

- [Psychiatric Mental Healthcare for Children, Teens, & Adults | Minnesota](https://prairie-care.com): PrairieCare homepage providing overview of psychiatric care services across Minnesota locations including Twin Cities, Rochester, and Mankato
